gloss: to be flexible; to be adaptable

definitions.gloss: to be flexible; to be adaptable; to be accommodating
definitions.explanation: To be able to adjust or adapt to changing circumstances. Describes a person, system, or approach that can handle things flexibly rather than rigidly.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}く{人|ひと}だ。
この{会社|かいしゃ}は{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}かない。
{小|ちい}さな{店|みせ}の{方|ほう}が{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}いて、{細|こま}かい{要望|ようぼう}にも{応|おう}じてくれる。
examples.english: A small shop is more flexible and will accommodate detailed requests.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with が{利|き}く (positive: is flexible) or が{利|き}かない (negative: is inflexible/rigid). The negative form is very common. Can describe people, organizations, rules, and systems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}く (to be flexible)
- {融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}かない (to be inflexible)
- {融通|ゆうずう}を{利|き}かせる (to exercise flexibility)
- {融通|ゆうずう}の{利|き}く (flexible; that can accommodate)
